notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

I want to apologize for the bugs that have affected your experience while playing the game.

This update has fixed some of the issues. There are some known issues still remain and I will work on it in the coming days. Thank you for your understanding and support.

Bugs Fix

 Fix Upgrade action not stopping after switch to other upgrades
 Fix game stuck after pressing controller button at Loading Page
 Fix Ability Calculation Display Page not appear when game is pausing
 Fix wrong skill icon display of some characters
